headline: Citrix NetScaler zero-days exploited; CISA orders patch, malware deployed
summary: Citrix confirmed two NetScaler remote-code-execution zero-days were being exploited and released fixes, while CISA ordered federal agencies to patch them. The Register reported a Sunday patch batch addressing three critical flaws plus five more, and said attackers used custom malware and web shells to steal credentials and move through networks at government, bank and professional-services targets.

claims.statement: Citrix confirmed two NetScaler RCE zero-days, CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772, were being exploited and released fixes.

sources.quote: Citrix has confirmed that two critical NetScaler remote code execution vulnerabilities, tracked as CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772, are being exploited in attacks and that it has released security updates to fix the flaws.

claims.statement: CISA ordered US federal agencies to patch the exploited Citrix flaws.

sources.quote: CISA orders feds to patch exploited Citrix flaws by Wednesday
has ordered U.S. government agencies over the weekend to secure their systems against attacks exploiting two critical Citrix NetScaler vulnerabilities.

claims.statement: A Sunday NetScaler patch batch fixed a trio of critical vulnerabilities plus five more serious issues.

sources.quote: Sunday NetScaler patch dump fixes trio of critical vulns and five more serious messes

claims.statement: Attackers exploited the zero-day to deploy custom web shells and tunneling malware, gaining root access and stealing credentials.

sources.quote: attackers exploited the Citrix NetScaler CVE-2026-88772 zero-day to deploy custom web shells and tunneling malware, gain root access, steal credentials, and spread into internal networks.

claims.statement: Custom malware was used in the attacks, which targeted government, banks and professional services.

sources.quote: Custom malware used in Citrix 0-day attacks targeting govt, banks, professional services

discrepancies.explanation: Bleepingcomputer and CISA describe two critical NetScaler vulnerabilities under attack, while The Register's patch-dump report counts three critical vulnerabilities fixed.
